intervals.quote: CUPID, the CUORE Upgrade with Particle IDentification, is a next-generation experiment to search for neutrinoless double beta decay ... It will be hosted by the CUORE cryostat located at the Laboratori Nazionali del Gran Sasso in Italy.

summary.plain: The team preparing CUPID, the planned successor to CUORE, which will search for a rare radioactive process using lithium-molybdate crystals in Italy.
summary.technical: CUPID Collaboration: preparing the proposed ~1500-crystal Li2MoO4 scintillating-bolometer successor to CUORE at LNGS; no source consulted (checked 2026-10-25) gives institution, member or country counts or a formation date.
